reviews.title: Good value for money, decent picture quality, awsome
reviews.comment:
For what this monitor offers at a price point of just a lil over 100$ depending if on sale its an excellent  monitor. Perfect for FPS games
Downfalls of the monitor, mobility is non existen but with a monitor arm, this monitor is goated. Decent color quality, easy to use with different color settings for the type of gaming you are playing. Would recommend to anyone looking for something that is slightly above decent if on sale
reviews.author: Andres

reviews.title: Really good monitors
reviews.comment: Good option for home office. Great value for the price, impressive what you can buy now for $99. I like the thin border for staking three on the same setup. The refresh rate is really good.
reviews.author: K

reviews.title: Great monitor for the price
reviews.comment: This monitor works like a charm. I don't use if for gaming, but as a secondary monitor for my laptop. It is very sharp and the colors are quite good. Setup is easy and for my windows 11 laptop, the connection was instantaneous and trouble-free.
reviews.author: bcape
